profile.research_note:
Location specific opening date, investment, and building detail were not confirmed this session; the town or county level Wikipedia page either omitted Meta entirely or gave only generic company level context. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget to confirm details directly.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is part of Meta multi-billion dollar owned and operated data center program. Company level Wikipedia coverage of Meta Platforms states that as of 2023 Facebook operated 21 data centers, that the company committed to purchasing 100 percent renewable energy and reducing greenhouse gas emissions 75 percent by 2020, and that Meta developed Fabric Aggregator, a distributed network system built to accommodate larger regions and varied traffic patterns across its data center fleet. In December 2024 Meta announced a 10 billion dollar investment in its largest AI data center, located in northeast Louisiana and powered by natural gas facilities, illustrating the scale of Meta continuing data center expansion, though that project is a separate site from this registry row. A Wikipedia page fetched this session for this specific location either did not mention a Meta facility at all or did not contain Meta specific opening dates, investment figures, building counts, or square footage, despite the registry operator attribution to Meta. No building specific address or individual MW figures were located in available sourcing this session.

reading.body:
Meta operates a facility in Eagle Mountain, Utah County, but has not published its power capacity. The site's computational scale and contribution to Meta's AI infrastructure therefore cannot be quantified from operator specifications.

Utah hosts 21 mapped data center facilities, of which only 9 publish power figures totaling 52.18 MW. This Meta campus ranks 10th by published capacity in the state, though that ranking reflects absence of a published figure rather than a measured one. The state context does not indicate whether this facility is among the 9 with published figures or among the 12 with no disclosed capacity.

Meta's data center program operates multiple owned and operated sites as part of its AI expansion strategy. Without published specifications for this Eagle Mountain location, the facility's relevance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from public data. Confirmation of the site's opening date, investment scale, building count, and power consumption would require direct sourcing beyond what is currently available.
